risk.reasoning: The branch's PRs were already closed without merge. The security concern it addresses (plaintext token storage) was resolved by PR #1007 (merged 2026-04-06) which touched the same file. The orphan branch approach adds typed intermediate objects with tautological runtime assertions (e.g., setting `storageData.token = tokenHash` then immediately checking `storageData.token !== tokenHash`) — these checks can never fire and add no real security value. Main has since received further auth improvements (PR #1674) to the same area. Merging would introduce dead assertion code and likely conflict with #1674.

recommendation.reasoning: Both PRs (#1323, #1358) for this branch were closed without merging. The security fix it aimed at is already covered by the earlier PR #1007 (same file, same concern, merged before this branch was created). The approach has a design flaw (tautological runtime assertions). No unmerged value remains.
